item.title: More than 10,000 nurses return to work after ratifying agreement with Montefiore, Mount Sinai
item.description: Nurses at Montefiore and Mount Sinai hospitals voted to ratify new contracts earlier this week, while nurses at NewYork-Presbyterian remain on strike.

item.description: Hundreds of couples gathered in Times Square to express their love, exchange vows and even renew promises.

item.description: The two-time Emmy nominated television special returned to abc7NY.

item.title: NYC's only Ethiopian-Israeli restaurant closing to walk-in customers after antisemitic threats
item.description: New York City's only Ethiopian-Israeli restaurant is closing its doors to walk-in customers as the owner says backlash over the Israel-Hamas war has taken a toll.

item.title: Prominent school photography company Lifetouch under scrutiny amid Epstein files rumor: What to know
item.description: Lifetouch, one of the most prominent school photography companies in the country, is facing district investigations and canceled school photo days over Jeffrey Epstein files rumors. Here's what parents and students should know.

item.title: Man sells ice cream from truck made almost entirely of snow on New Jersey lawn
item.description: The vehicle is parked on a front lawn on Springfield Avenue in Cranford. It has four wheels, reflectors and signage, but just about everything else is packed accumulations from the big storm.

item.title: Man fatally shot during dispute inside Queens laundromat
item.description: Police were called to the scene for an assault in progress at Wash and Fold Super Laundry on North Conduit Avenue in Springfield Gardens on Saturday morning.

item.title: Arrest made after women randomly pushed on subway tracks, assaulted in Brooklyn
item.description: An arrest has been made in a random subway shoving attack in Brooklyn.

item.title: European nations say Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with dart frog toxin
item.description: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with a rare and lethal toxin found in the skin of poison dart frogs, five European countries said.
